readings: Group result rows by races.name across all years, summing results.points for each name. Find the average of those name-level point totals and keep names whose totals exceed it. Return one row with the sum of the kept names’ point totals, the average results.laps across all result rows for those names, and the average amount by which each kept name’s point total exceeds the overall name-level average.

Group result rows by races.name across all years, summing results.points and averaging results.laps within each name. Find the average of the name-level point totals and keep names whose totals exceed it. Return one row with the sum of the kept names’ point totals, the unweighted average of their name-level average laps, and the average amount by which each kept name’s point total exceeds the overall name-level average.
queries:
WITH name_totals AS (
  SELECT races.name, SUM(results.points) AS total_points
  FROM results
  JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
),
overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_points
  FROM name_totals
),
kept_names AS (
  SELECT name, total_points, total_points - avg_points AS excess
  FROM name_totals
  CROSS JOIN overall_average
  WHERE total_points > avg_points
)
SELECT
  SUM(total_points),
  (
    SELECT AVG(CAST(results.laps AS REAL))
    FROM results
    JOIN races ON races.raceId = results.raceId
    JOIN kept_names ON kept_names.name = races.name
  ),
  AVG(excess)
FROM kept_names

WITH name_stats AS (
    SELECT ra.name,
           SUM(re.points) AS total_points,
           AVG(re.laps) AS avg_laps
    FROM results AS re
    JOIN races AS ra ON ra.raceId = re.raceId
    GROUP BY ra.name
),
overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_points) AS avg_total_points
    FROM name_stats
)
SELECT SUM(n.total_points),
       AVG(n.avg_laps),
       AVG(n.total_points - o.avg_total_points)
FROM name_stats AS n
CROSS JOIN overall AS o
WHERE n.total_points > o.avg_total_points
